name: Shirachuu Tankenbu
source:
Shirachuu Tankenbu is about a group of friends that get a postcard with "STB" inscribed on it, that leads them to return to the village where they spent their holidays together. This will prompt the main hero, Takahiro, to recall major events from years ago, while trying to identify the person behind the mystery.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPM-65660.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
Shirachuu Tankenbu讲述了一群朋友收到一张写有“STB”的明信片，这让他们回到了一起度过假期的村庄。这将促使主角贵宏回忆起多年前的重大事件，同时试图找出谜团背后的人物。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPM-65660.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
